changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 2 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6237-wizard-step-config-split.md`

- names `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` → `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` — edited by this change

  > Documentation repair in the same stroke: the support table in the README and in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` still said `formType: 'tabbed'` sections drop the predicate. That stopped being true when the tabbed arm landed — the row now reads **Yes**, the surrounding prose no longer claims two inert arms or a diagnostic that fires for `tabbed`, and the wizard row stays **No**, which is still exactly true.

### `.changeset/8738-object-form-fields-description.md`

- names `ObjectForm.tsx` → `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The registration declared `{ name: 'fields', type: 'array' }` with no description, so an author had nowhere to read that this key's members are **bare field names** — a different vocabulary from `sections[].fields`, which also accepts the spec `FormFieldSchema` object (identity key `field`, e.g. `{ field: 'note', colSpan: 2 }`). Moving one of those objects to the top-level `fields` resolves to no name and is skipped by `SimpleObjectForm` (`ObjectForm.tsx`) and by `buildFlatFields` (`flatFields.ts`, shared by the drawer/modal presentations). Behaviour is unchanged by this entry; it only adds the description text an author would need to avoid the drop before writing it.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `7a564e004` (merge-base with origin/main): 10 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1301 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1870 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36040016442)

Adopted verbatim in substance from an isolated at-tier reviewer by `domain:ui` seat 3, 2026-09-24T16:00Z. Tier read off the reviewer's transcript by this seat: 52 of 52 stamped requests `claude-fable-5-1` = `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Seat re-measured the FAIL items at the head: `plugin-form.mdx:287` and changeset lines 5 and 15 say 「on every layout」, changeset line 31 says 「so it is unchanged」, and `SplitForm.tsx:395` still gates on `section.label || section.description`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Item 2, one row rule: met. `sectionDrawsDividerRow` = title OR description; `projectSectionDivider` takes no gate; `SectionDividerGate` has 0 hits in `packages/` and `content/`. `fieldGroups.ts` is not in the barrel, so no published export moved.
- Item 1, group semantics independent of the heading: met on the default, modal and drawer arms. Every projected row carries `visibleWhen` plus the resolved members. A headingless group that has a predicate gets a chrome-less `__section_gate_KEY` row, which `SectionDivider` renders as null (the `TabbedForm` precedent). `hiddenSectionFieldNames` hides only that row's own `fields`, so a predicate never hides more than its group.
- Item 3, the control lives on the row: met. A `collapsible`/`collapsed` group with no title and no description resolves OPEN with no toggle. The diagnostic's first sentence is the ruling's wording verbatim, sent once per section through the package's existing `console.warn` channel. Pinned in `headinglessCollapseDiagnostic-9849`.
- The modal pair: met. `ModalFormSectionConfig` gains optional `collapsible`/`collapsed`; both stacked modal pushes resolve them with per-section live state; ObjectForm's modal map copies them. The multi-section `tabbed` path is untouched.
- Flipped pins flip for the ruling's reason (8071 rows 8–9, the `collapseResolution-9849` modal rows, `drawerFormSectionDescription-9834` row 5). No remaining pin asserts the old per-arm gate.
- Docs and changeset: true except three over-reaching sentences, all listed under the verdict.

### ② Semver level

- `minor` on `@object-ui/plugin-form`: correct. Two new optional members on an exported type, plus published renderer behaviour; nothing removed. `Changeset Bump Policy` and `Changeset Declaration` are success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- 8071 rows 8–9 and the `plugin-form.mdx` section, both outside the claim's named set: accepted. The first is forced by 「B refused」; the second is owed under AGENTS.md's docs-driven rule, subject to the wording fix below.
- `resetHeadinglessCollapseWarnings` export: module-internal, not in the barrel. Accepted.
- ModalForm first-load editable window (seat 2's note `5815429411`): untouched, correctly; no carrier yet.
- `SplitForm` and `TabbedForm` build their own rows outside `projectSectionDivider`. A headingless `SplitForm` section with `visibleWhen` stays un-gated (`SplitForm.tsx:395`). The ruling's stated landing is the three arms, so this is not this PR's defect, but item 1 says 「on every arm」. Raised to the maintainer/director in the round report.
- `Spec Main Shape Gate`: an upstream drift, not this PR's (objectui#10287).

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-9849-section-gate-rule-e`
Reviewed-by: `session_01D486C1axmXnrkJMNUfz2eb`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Prose-only; the code, pins and semver level pass. Required fixes:
1. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` (new section, bullet 1): scope 「on every layout」 to the default, modal and drawer layouts. It is false for `SplitForm` and the wizard.
2. `.changeset/9849-section-gate-rule-e.md`: scope 「on every layout」 the same way at lines 5 and 15.
3. `.changeset/9849-section-gate-rule-e.md` line 31: 「so it is unchanged」 is false for a single-section `tabbed` modal, which falls through to the stacked path (`groups.length > 1` guard). Qualify it with 「with more than one section」 or drop the clause.
